item.title: Pakistani Shiites rally to denounce US-Israeli strikes on Iran as US Embassy issues a security alert
item.summary: Hundreds of minority Shiites are rallying in Pakistan’s capital and elsewhere in the country to denounce the killing of Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei in a U.S.-Israeli campaign as the U.S. Embassy In Islamabad issued a security alert war...

item.title: Japan, Canada sign strategic agreement in defense and energy as war in Mideast fuels oil concerns
item.summary: Japan and Canada have signed a strategic agreement aimed at strengthening cooperation in defense, economic and energy security as military strikes on Iran by the United States and Israel fueled concern about international oil supplies

item.title: US imposes visa restrictions on Rwandan officials after sanctions targeting military
item.summary: The U.S. is imposing visa restrictions on “several senior Rwandan officials for fueling instability” in eastern Congo, the State Department said on Friday, intensifying pressure on the East African country after sanctions announced earlier this week

item.title: Motorists stranded and military deployed after heavy rains pound Kenyan capital overnight
item.summary: Motorists in the Kenyan capital were stranded for hours after roads were flooded following heavy rains overnight

item.title: Islamic militants abduct more than 300 people in northeastern Nigeria, officials say
item.summary: Local officials say Islamic militants attacked a town in northeastern Nigeria, abducting more than 300 people, including women and children

item.title: Pakistan, Afghanistan claim killing dozens of other's troops in relentless fighting
item.summary: Pakistani and Afghan officials say their forces have launched multiple strikes at each other in cross-border clashes, with each side claiming to have killed dozens more enemy troops in what has been the deadliest fighting yet between the two neighbors

item.title: UN report says Ugandan troops helped South Sudan with deadly airstrikes
item.summary: A U.N. inquiry says Uganda helped South Sudan carry out airstrikes that killed and badly burned civilians in opposition areas

item.title: Hong Kong firm seeks $2 billion over Panama's takeover of 2 key canal ports
item.summary: A subsidiary of a Hong Kong-based company that has lost control of two critical ports on the Panama Canal says it is seeking $2 billion of compensation in damages from Panama over its “illegal” takeover of the ports

item.title: Ex-rapper's political party leads early results in Nepal's first election since 2025 youth revolt
item.summary: Preliminary and partial results show that a new political party led by an ex-rapper leading Nepal’s parliamentary election, the country’s first since last year’s youth-led revolt

item.title: Women in South Africa take up guns and martial arts for protection against gender violence
item.summary: Women in South Africa are turning to guns and martial arts for self-defense in a country where rates of gender-based violence are extremely high
